title: Whole-operation writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Exercise direct public writer entry points for generated LINE, 3DLINE, RAY, XLINE, SOLID, TRACE, LIGHT, CAMERA-to-VIEW, plain/embedded-MTEXT GEOPOSITIONMARKER, variable-vertex SECTIONOBJECT, MPOLYGON, VIEWPORT, OLE2FRAME, OLEFRAME, SHAPE, RASTERVARIABLES, DICTIONARYVAR, DBCOLOR, linked PDF UNDERLAY/definition, one LTYPE table row, one typed XRECORD, and one text-only MULTILEADER, and current/legacy dynamic-constraint DIMENSION profiles alongside all seven standard typed DIMENSION subtypes, ARC_DIMENSION, LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, RTEXT and ARCALIGNEDTEXT in the whole-operation ASCII/Binary allocation failure sweep.

generatedProfiles.profile: generated text-only; no leader roots or style references

commonFields.construction: Typed DRW_* dimension records serialized in the existing generated whole-operation drawing

allocationSweep.ascii: 920/920 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.
allocationSweep.binary: 899/899 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.

validation.readback: Exactly one callback was delivered for each of the seven standard subtypes, ARC_DIMENSION, LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, RTEXT and ARCALIGNEDTEXT, plus LINE, 3DLINE, RAY, XLINE, SOLID, TRACE, LIGHT, CAMERA and VIEW, two GEOPOSITIONMARKER profiles, SECTIONOBJECT, MPOLYGON, VIEWPORT, OLE2FRAME, OLEFRAME, SHAPE, RASTERVARIABLES, DICTIONARYVAR, DBCOLOR, PDFUNDERLAY, PDFDEFINITION and one LTYPE and one generated typed XRECORD selected by payload among multiple XRECORDs. The XRECORD group 1 string, group 90 integer, custom-dictionary parent and named dictionary entry match; MULTILEADER callback, closed context and generated text/base/location/height match; both dynamic-constraint DIMENSION profiles are delivered through the linear-dimension callback; the legacy layer spelling is emitted/read back normalized as `*ADSK_CONSTRAINTS`, with labels, modeled points and all twelve DSTYLE overrides retained. Common text/style fields and subtype-specific WCS/OCS geometry match typed profiles; large radial chord, overridden center, jog point and group-40 jog angle match; tolerance style, text, insertion, extrusion and axis match; RTEXT style, position, height, rotation, flags, text and extrusion match; arc-aligned text geometry, font names, D2T fields, color, flags and text match; direct 3DLINE/RAY/XLINE/SOLID/TRACE entry points preserve typed geometry; LIGHT fields match; CAMERA-to-VIEW remapping closes; both GeoPositionMarker outer profiles match, and the enabled profile retains embedded MTEXT text/geometry; SECTIONOBJECT and MPOLYGON fields and variable vertex paths match; VIEWPORT paper dimensions, status/id, center, target, view height, snap/grid spacing and stylesheet match; both locally generated OLE frame payloads and OLE2 frame metadata match typed readback; SHAPE DXF-visible style and geometry match; RASTERVARIABLES fields match; DICTIONARYVAR schema/value, parent and named root membership match; DBCOLOR RGB/ACI/book fields, parent and named root membership match; UNDERLAY reference resolves to the PDF definition and both clip paths and modeled fields match; LTYPE description, dash path, size and length match.

limitations: This verifies allocation rollback/retry and typed DXF roundtrip only; it does not qualify native entity presentation or producer-specific DWG semantics.
The CAMERA graph proof covers one generated VIEW record and one handle role; broader VIEW dependencies and producer variants remain open.
SECTIONOBJECT's nonzero section-settings handle route and raw-only color domain are not covered.
MPOLYGON associative boundary handles and edge/spline paths are not covered.
VIEWPORT optional reference roles (background, shade plot, clip boundary, UCS, visual style and sun) are not covered.
The OLE payload byte strings are locally generated opaque transaction probes, not valid application-authored embedded OLE documents or consumer qualification.
The SHAPE probe covers its DXF-visible fields only; SHAPE's DWG glyph index and SHAPEFILE relationship are not represented by this DXF profile.
RASTERVARIABLES transaction coverage does not qualify its ACAD_IMAGE_VARS named-object-dictionary edge or raster consumer behavior.
DICTIONARYVAR and DBCOLOR root membership and parent readback are checked, but the encoded owner/pointer role is not independently inspected in this control.
The UNDERLAY pair verifies the entity's definition handle target and typed readback; it does not qualify named underlay dictionary membership or native PDF display.

The LTYPE test covers serialization transaction and DXF typed fields only; it does not implement LibreCAD PR #3269's adapter-side comparison of edited LC_LineType definitions against archived DRW_LType records.

The typed XRECORD control uses a generated profile and verifies allocation rollback/retry, its two typed payload values and dictionary graph edge only; it is not independent source-profile, producer interoperability or consumer semantic evidence.
The MULTILEADER transaction uses one generated text-only context; leader roots/lines, block content, style-reference resolution and native consumer semantics are not covered.

The dynamic-constraint DIMENSION controls use generated generic profiles for current and legacy layer spellings and all twelve modeled DSTYLE overrides; they verify rollback/retry, normalization and typed field readback only. Native constraint evaluation, display, and independent physical group-70 absence inspection are not covered.
Custom/dynamic dimension profiles and broader public writer profiles remain outside this control.
No full test suite was run.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was committed; the drawing is generated by the test in scratch storage.
